title: Bright Star
identity_notes: Ziv-syndicated newspaper comedy-drama centered on Hillsdale Morning Star editor Susan Armstrong and reporter George Harvey. The frozen container preserves 31 numbered broadcasts from the 52-program run plus five OTRR reference tracks; all 31 surviving broadcast dates are recovered additively from specialist collection metadata.
